notes.title: 1.3 Update is coming!
notes.notes:
Many complain that the game is too difficult. We listened to your requests and has released this update which includes:
[list]
    [*]Now Van Darkholme has 6 lives.
    [*]Simplified enemies.
    [*]In the level set signs that will help you to know what lies ahead.
    [*]Slightly redesigned levels.
[/list]

If you have ideas or suggestions about our game, create your own theme in the tab 'Discussion'! We will read and reply your theme!
